name: Kyushu University
summary: National university in Fukuoka, founded 1911: English-taught engineering and agriculture programmes, plus a bilingual interdisciplinary school.

handoff.label: Undergraduate school, language of instruction: English

ib.text: Predicted IB grades are accepted with a school seal (conditional offer); finals due by 20 or 31 August 2027, by programme. Each programme scores set IB subjects, and IB taken in another language needs an English test.

apply.via: Kyushu online system, then documents by post

dates.label: Required documents must be received by post, 17:00 JST
Final IB grades due by email (engineering and interdisciplinary school)
Final IB grades due by email (agriculture)

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
programmes.about: Electricity, electronics, communication, data science and computers in one programme, from power systems and sensing to AI, networks and security; taught wholly in English apart from Japanese classes.
programmes.ib: IB scored on Maths AA HL and Physics HL and/or Computer Science HL; the published combination is 5-5.
programmes.selectionNote: Preliminary screening on documents and test results, then an online interview between 24 February and 4 March 2027. Limited places; one programme per applicant.

programmes.name: Applied Chemistry
programmes.about: Materials with structure and function controlled at atomic and molecular level, covering organic, inorganic and biomolecular chemistry for IT, environmental, nano and biotechnology; taught in English.
programmes.ib: IB scored on Maths HL and Chemistry HL; the published combination is 6-6.
programmes.selectionNote: Preliminary screening on documents and test results, then an online interview between 24 February and 4 March 2027. Limited places; one programme per applicant.

programmes.name: Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
programmes.about: Mechanical engineering across precision instruments, robots, automobiles, rockets and energy technology, in the monozukuri tradition of making things; taught in English apart from Japanese classes.
programmes.ib: The IB is not among the accepted tests listed for this programme: only EJU Maths Course 2 or SAT Maths 740. Ask the admissions office.
programmes.selectionNote: The instructions list only EJU Maths and SAT Maths (minimum 740) for this programme, then an online interview between 24 February and 4 March 2027.

programmes.name: Civil Engineering
programmes.about: Social infrastructure such as water and sewage, roads and ports, plus restoring damaged natural environments, with hardware and software for building design, urban planning and soil and water environment; taught in English.
programmes.ib: IB scored on Maths HL and Chemistry HL and/or Physics HL; the published combination is 5-5.
programmes.selectionNote: Preliminary screening on documents and test results, then an online interview between 24 February and 4 March 2027. Limited places; one programme per applicant.

programmes.name: Bioresource and Bioenvironment
programmes.about: School of Agriculture's International Undergraduate Program, taught entirely in English: basic and applied sciences, natural and social, behind bio-production, bio-function and bio-environment. Apply under Type B if you studied outside Japan.
programmes.ib: Your IB Group 4 (sciences) and Group 5 (mathematics) grades are used for screening; no minimum grades are published.
programmes.selectionNote: Type B route for applicants educated outside Japan: documents and test results, then a second screening in late February or early March 2027.

programmes.name: Interdisciplinary Science and Innovation
programmes.about: A school without humanities-science boundaries, stressing communication, design thinking, data analysis and project management. The programme is bilingual: classes run in English and Japanese, not English alone.
programmes.ib: Bilingual, not English-only. IB scored on Group 5 maths plus either Group 3 or Group 4 subjects.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents and test results first; second screening on 25 and 26 February 2027. Limited places.

notes: Applicants living outside Japan get half of first-year tuition off (¥133,950 a term instead of ¥267,900), and a one-off ¥282,000 enrolment fee applies.
A few high-scoring successful applicants may be put forward by Kyushu for a MEXT scholarship (¥117,000 a month for four years, fees waived), if the ministry approves.
You may apply to only one Kyushu undergraduate programme for October 2027, across engineering, agriculture and the interdisciplinary school.
